title: Parkio Daily for September 28, 2026
teaser: Tiana's Bayou Adventure closed with drained water; Big Thunder also down. Joffrey's pours $1 coffee tomorrow. Bakso the tiger leaves Animal Kingdom soon.

rides.name: Flight of Passage
rides.note: Lower waits before Bakso viewing surge

breaking.title: Tiana's Bayou Adventure down with water drained at Magic Kingdom
breaking.body: The ride closed around 10:11 a.m. today for unknown reasons. An hour later, observers noticed the attraction's water had been mostly drained, suggesting technical work beyond a routine pause.

parkioInsight.text: Frontierland is likely to feel congested with both Tiana's and Big Thunder offline. Rope-drop Space Mountain or Haunted Mansion instead, then circle back after lunch if reopening updates appear.

breaking.title: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad also closed today
breaking.body: The coaster went offline today for reasons not yet disclosed by Disney. No reopening estimate has been posted.

parkioInsight.text: With both Frontierland headliners dark, wait times at Seven Dwarfs and Peter Pan tend to spike. Prioritize those rides in the first operating hour or save them for late evening.

bignews.title: Joffrey's offering $1 coffee across Walt Disney World tomorrow
bignews.body: All Joffrey's locations will sell 16 oz. hot coffee and 24 oz. iced coffee for one dollar on Tuesday, September 29, in celebration of National Coffee Day.

parkioInsight.text: Lines at Joffrey's kiosks usually peak between 9–10 a.m. Grabbing your dollar cup right at park open or mid-afternoon typically saves five to ten minutes in queue.

bignews.title: Bakso the tiger leaving Animal Kingdom soon
bignews.body: The Sumatran tiger, who turned two today, will relocate to a new habitat outside Walt Disney World in the coming weeks. Guests have limited time to see him on the Maharajah Jungle Trek.

parkioInsight.text: Viewing windows on the trek tend to be busiest late morning. Visiting before 10 a.m. or after 4 p.m. often offers clearer sightlines and a quieter experience with Bakso before his transfer.

bignews.title: Walt Disney World Railroad enters month-long refurbishment
bignews.body: The Magic Kingdom train closed today and will remain unavailable through late October, according to the park calendar.

parkioInsight.text: Without the railroad shortcut, walking from Main Street to Fantasyland adds roughly eight minutes. Budget extra time between lands or use the ferry to shorten the loop if feet are tired.

bignews.title: Turf Club Bar and Grill reopens Tuesday at Saratoga Springs
bignews.body: The restaurant returns September 30 with a menu inspired by turn-of-the-century Upstate New York racing culture. Reservations are now available.

parkioInsight.text: Opening-week slots at newly reopened restaurants usually fill within 48 hours. Booking dinner for later this week now may secure a table before walk-up waits climb.

topstories.title: Disney Store raises ear headband prices online
topstories.body: All standard ear headbands now cost $39.99, up from $36.99. In-park price increases typically follow in October.

parkioInsight.text: If a specific headband style is on your list, ordering online today locks the current price before potential in-park increases next month. Delivery usually takes three to five business days.

topstories.title: EPCOT hours shortened for 2026 Festival of the Holidays
topstories.body: The park will close earlier than in prior years during the November and December festival, according to the newly posted calendar.

parkioInsight.text: Shorter hours often compress evening crowds. Plan World Showcase dining before 6 p.m. and tackle Remy and Frozen right at rope drop to stay ahead of bottlenecks.

topstories.title: Atlantic Dance Hall closes after 30 years at BoardWalk
topstories.body: The nightclub wrapped its final weekend September 25–27. A new concept called Hurly Burly is set to replace it with different food, drinks, and entertainment.

parkioInsight.text: Hurly Burly's opening week usually draws curious crowds. Visiting on a weeknight rather than Friday or Saturday often means shorter waits for tables and a quieter atmosphere.

topstories.title: Citizen pop-up in Magic Kingdom today only
topstories.body: Uptown Jewelers hosts a one-day showcase featuring limited-edition D23 watches not typically sold in the parks.

parkioInsight.text: Pop-up inventory is usually limited. Stopping at Uptown Jewelers before 11 a.m. tends to offer the widest selection before popular styles sell through.

topstories.title: Annual Passholders hit reservation capacity this weekend
topstories.body: For the first time in weeks, several Walt Disney World parks blocked additional passholder reservations on Saturday and Sunday.

parkioInsight.text: Reservation limits often signal heavier attendance. Weekdays this week may offer lighter crowds as weekend visitors clear out; mid-morning arrival typically avoids both rope-drop and lunch rushes.

topstories.title: Bluey meet-and-greet continues at Disneyland
topstories.body: Bluey and Bingo remain available for character encounters following their resort debut earlier this week.

parkioInsight.text: New character meets tend to draw longest lines in the first two weeks. Arriving at the encounter location within 30 minutes of park open usually keeps wait times under 20 minutes.

topstories.title: Halloween treats available across Walt Disney World through October 31
topstories.body: Seasonal menu items include the Boneyard Brownie and other themed snacks at quick-service locations parkwide.

parkioInsight.text: Popular seasonal items sometimes run out by late afternoon at high-traffic counters. Grabbing a Halloween treat mid-morning or after 3 p.m. often avoids both crowds and stockouts.

icymi.title: Magic Kingdom celebrates 55 years on October 1
icymi.body: The park opened in 1971 and marks its 55th anniversary this week. Commemorative merchandise is available.

icymi.title: Disney Cruise Line to unveil Disney Believe on October 7
icymi.body: A livestream will reveal details about the new ship, scheduled to set sail in 2027.

icymi.title: eet by Maneet Chauhan now on Too Good To Go app
icymi.body: The Disney Springs restaurant joined the food-waste reduction platform, offering discounted surplus meals.

icymi.title: Vacation Fun short reopens at Hollywood Studios
icymi.body: The Mickey and Minnie animated film returned one day later than the park calendar originally listed.

spotlight.title: Disneyland popcorn bucket and sipper guide updated
spotlight.body: The official Disney Parks Blog published a fresh catalog of novelty containers currently available across Disneyland and California Adventure, including Halloween designs.

parkioInsight.text: Seasonal buckets and sippers often sell out at flagship popcorn carts by early afternoon. Stopping at a cart in the first two hours of park operation usually ensures the widest selection.
